answer: A farm running 96 keys thus pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. Because the sparrow stake is held until the river settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the quill audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 29% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
